text:
maya: kicking off a canary for oxbird-4b-int8. goal is to validate perf and quality before wider activation. hosting modes: hosted + dedicated (SJC small pool). private/offline not in scope for this run. please review plan below and flag blockers.
aj: ack. what traffic split and timeline are you proposing?
maya: plan: 5% prod -> 1h smoke. if smoke green then 15% -> 4h extended. metrics gating: P99 latency (user-facing) must not exceed 2x baseline, error rate < 0.5%, quality regression < 2 percentage points on our intent eval. rollback immediate on any severe regression or sustained SLO breach.
kevin: evauls are uploaded: https://internal.redwood/evals/oxbird-4b-int8/2026-03-18. quick numbers vs raven-7b-int8 baseline: raven-7b-int8 p99=85ms, qscore=87. oxbird-4b-int8 p99=120ms, qscore=84 (intent-wise drop on "summarize-legal" and "code-review"). see per-intent breakdown in link.
sahil: quant note: this is per-channel int8 with L2 calibration on activations. int4 experiments exist but not production-ready for this model (we saw hallucination increase on long-context). memory: model fits one A100-40G with 2x KV cache heatup. recommended KV warmup window = 5k tokens.
maya: dedicated config: SJC pool, 4 nodes (autoscale min=2 max=8), batch target=16, max_latency_slo_ms=400 for internal routing. hosted config: batch target=8 to keep latency down.
deploy-bot: Canary created: oxbird-4b-int8-canary id=cny-oxb-2234. Routing rule applied to prod namespace. Initial traffic=0.05.
aj: smoke tests to run (QA): 1) 50 concurrent short prompts, 2) 10 long-context sessions (8k tokens), 3) edge-case parsing + function-calling. Please post failures.
qa-bot: smoke-run started. harness: /infra/e2e/canary_harness:v2. Will post summary when complete.
kevin: A/B eval plan: use eval harness v3, sample 10k queries split by intent. Quality metrics: helpfulness pass rate, instruction-follow rate, hallucination score (manual subset). Threshold: delta-helpfulness >= -2 pts triggers review; >= -5 pts auto rollback. Also compute per-intent deltas, prioritize legal/finance intents.
sahil: cache and batching suggestions: enable prefix_cache=true for hosted; dedicated can use prefix_cache + persistent KV with warmup. target batch_size=8 (hosted) / 16 (dedicated). set autoscaling cooldown to 90s for canary to avoid oscillation.
maya: fallback policies: primary fallback -> route to raven-7b-int8 (same region). Emergency fallback -> degrade to raven-3b (lower cost model) if sustained high errors. Automatic fallback triggered by either: a) quality regression > 3 pts over 15m, or b) P99 latency > 3x baseline for 10m, or c) error rate > 1% for 5m.
aj: rollback/runbook snippet?
maya: runbook excerpt: 
```
# stop traffic
redwood route update --name prod --model oxbird-4b-int8-canary --traffic 0
# set fallback
redwood route update --name prod --fallback raven-7b-int8
# notify
@oncall-eng paging: "oxbird canary rollback - reason: <metric>"
```
kevin: on-call thresholds: page if P95 > 500ms or error rate > 1% sustained 5m. Also page if eval delta helpfulness <= -5 pts.
sahil: logging: enable token-level latency sampling on canary for first 30m. capture KV cache hit rate and attention kernel time per step.
qa-bot: smoke-run done: 5 failures out of 1200 requests (timeouts on long-context). full eval in ~45m. Posting artifacts shortly.
maya: thanks. if full eval passes gating we proceed to 50% gradual over 24h with hourly monitors. If anything odd, escalate to eng-ml pager and pause activation.
kevin: noted. thumbs up. :thumbsup:
